pageDescription: Install apps with WinGet, apply reversible tweaks, and configure Windows features — inspired by WinUtil.

install.heading: Install
install.description: Use WinGet to install, upgrade, or uninstall popular applications without hunting for download links.
install.wingetMissingHint: Install App Installer from the Microsoft Store to use this tab.
install.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more apps first

tweaks.heading: Tweaks
tweaks.description: Apply reversible Windows privacy and performance tweaks. Running selected tweaks creates a System Restore Point before changes are made.
tweaks.windowsOnly: Tweaks are available on Windows only
tweaks.essentialDescription: Recommended privacy defaults for most Windows installs.
tweaks.advancedDescription: Deeper system policy and service changes for users who understand the tradeoffs.
tweaks.advancedCaution: CAUTION: Advanced tweaks can change Windows services, scheduled tasks, or AI features. Review each selected item before running.
tweaks.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more tweaks first
tweaks.powerPlansDescription: Switch between Windows Balanced mode and Ultimate Performance.
tweaks.powerPlanUnavailable: Power plans are unavailable on this system
tweaks.shutUpDescription: Open O&O ShutUp10++ if it is installed, or open the official download page.

config.comingSoonDescription: Windows optional features (.NET, Hyper-V, WSL, Sandbox), legacy Control Panel launchers, OpenSSH server, and one-click fixes.
